question: Which Chandrayaan-1 payload is linked both to imaging solar-wind interaction at the lunar surface and to ESA–ISRO development?
answer: The Chandrayaan-1 payload that is linked to both imaging solar-wind interaction at the lunar surface and to ESA-ISRO development is the Mini-Magnetospheres Probe (MMP). The MMP was designed to study the interaction of solar wind with the lunar surface and to investigate the formation of mini-magnetospheres. The data collected by the MMP has been used for scientific analysis and has contributed to our understanding of the Moon's magnetic field and its interaction with the solar wind. Additionally, the MMP was developed in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA) and was a key component of the Chandrayaan-1 mission.

The AO is open to all faculty and researchers from recognized academia, research institutions, Universities, Colleges and government organizations of India. General guidelines for the proposal submission: The selection of the research proposal by a review committee depends a lot on the write-up of the proposal, novelty of the idea, innovative science and useful deliverables in terms of enhancing scientific knowledge. It is important for the proposer to understand the capability of the payload with respect to intended science. The instrumentation details of the payloads, which are similar to Chandrayaan-2 lander and rover payloads are published in the journal Current Science. Two hardcopies of the proposal prepared as per the formats given in Annexure-1, Annexure -2 and Annexure 3. The complete proposal needs to be forwarded by Head of the Institutions along with the seal. The hard copy of the proposal shall be sent to the following address: Director, Science Programme Office ISRO Head Quarters, Antariksh Bhavan, New BEL Road, Bangalore-560094 The format for proposal includes a Declaration to be signed by the Principal Investigator and the Head of the Institution. The soft copy of the proposal has to be mailed to science[at]isro[dot]gov[dot]in with the subject Attn : Ch3 data AO . A proposal received without the forwarding letter signed by the Head of the Institutions will not be considered. Who can submit proposal: Proposals could be submitted by individuals or a group of scientists and academicians from Universities, Colleges, national institutions, outside ISRO/ DOS. Only
